CustomField.formula: IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c,'Active'), Past_Due_Balance__c > 0 ), 'Delinquent', IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c,'Active'), Past_Due_Balance__c <= 0 ), 'Current', IF( ISPICKVAL(Status__c,'Cancelled'), 'Cancelled', IF( ISPICKVAL(Status__c,'Completed'), 'Completed', 'NA' ))))
CustomField.label: Payment Status
